system.flavor:
Light every torch in a hall at once, burn a stand of brush to clear a path, drive a crowd back from a gate with a wall of heat, melt through an iron bar, or dry a soaked company by a roaring fire in a wet camp. A forge's worth of fire for one scene.

Not enough to burn down a house, hold a street, or keep burning after you stop.

body.label: Target
body.html: Enemies in a cone of length 4.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, each target takes 1 Fire Damage.

surges.html: Exclude one creature from the cone.
One hit target gains Burning until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Elemental
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 3 Mana to enter Elemental Full Manifestation (FM-2E). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
